Work key: O02.5
Accountable role (person unassigned): Operations engineer with institutional operator
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Let authorized operators diagnose work and policy changes through supported interfaces.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O02 (bd-01M4W40K6BGH2A78J8820FP8M6)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Provide bounded filters/pages for audit events, operation attempts/checkpoints and actionable failures with actor/time/correlation attribution.
2. Separate operator diagnostics and source evidence from researcher-facing errors and project activity.
3. Enforce current inspection permissions and redact secrets/private payloads; retry/cancel actions identify exact operations and follow their supported transitions.

Verification: API/CLI operator journey, pagination and unauthorized/canary disclosure tests.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O02.5/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:
- modules/service/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/ApiServer.scala
- modules/objects/src/main/scala/sanctity/objects/FileBlobStore.scala
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/DurableImports.scala

- F03.3: bd-01M4W5P5MCD12DVHWQC1KFXNDP
- O02.1: bd-01M4W5P86V3ZV697KZ1F85XFM4

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
